name: BigRep STUDIO.2 / STUDIO G2 (T0 active, T1 idle; LiDAR scan, uncalibrated)
provenance: BigRep STUDIO.2 (STUDIO G2) dual-extruder head, T0 (active) nozzle. NOT CAD: body bands come from an iPhone LiDAR scan of the head plus hand-clicked nozzle tip points; scan accuracy roughly +-2-3 mm. Not calibrated. Frame: origin = T0 nozzle tip, X/Y = printer axes (assumed; the two nozzles sit side by side along X), Z up, mm. Scanned body xy extents per height band: z4-8 nozzle plate around both nozzles x[-34.5,10.3] y[-25.6,23.0]; z8-15 x[-48.7,55.8] y[-38.0,29.1]; z15-90 x[-87.6,61.9] y[-66.8,31.1]; z90-345 x[-87.6,63.0] y[-70.7,45.6]. Idle T1 (retracted while T0 prints): clicked tip at x=-31.7 y=-1.6 z=+6.2, modelled as box x[-36,-27] y[-6,3] z[6.2,8] (box size estimated around the clicked tip). One head per print: the engine takes a single nonplanar_head per printer, so this T0-origin envelope is used for both extruders; printing with T1 active is NOT covered by this envelope. Nozzle: 0.6 mm nozzle protruding about 4 mm below the body (scan). The cone shape is an ESTIMATE, not measured: a conservative linear cone from a 0.6 mm tip-flat radius to 5 mm radius at z=4, stepped in nozzle boxes; tip allowance 3 mm / 1 mm as in the other heads. Margins: axial and lateral 2 mm to absorb scan error (larger than any other head in the library). x_gantry_estimate: ESTIMATE only. The scan shows the head reaching up to about z=345 where the gantry starts; the gantry is modelled as an X-infinite box from z=345 spanning the top body band's Y extent plus 50 mm each side; its true section and position are not measured. Derived 2026-11-17; calibrated=false.
